hook: Visit the four instrument families at the zoo and tap 22 instruments to hear real recordings. Then guess who is playing from the sound alone, and build a zoo band.
outcome: Name the four instrument families and how each makes sound, recognize common instruments by sight and sound, and hear that bigger instruments play lower notes
sources: Instrument recordings: University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios, Musical Instrument Samples (free to use without restriction)
Harp, timpani, drums and triangle synthesized in the browser
Illustrations generated with Google Gemini, edited for Curio Class
